answer: With a Verified email inbox bound by signed confirmation letter with annual re-verification, the account is only as strong as its binding: the verified email inbox answers a fresh challenge, the signed confirmation letter is recorded, and annual re-verification keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so losing the channel means losing the identity, and fakes cannot hide behind throwaway channels. One forge proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of bindings. After the cedar closes and the garden opens, the claim is frozen and published for audit.
